name: Shankar Lal Rampal Dye-Chem Li
summary: Shankar Lal Rampal Dye-Chem Limited, founded in 2005 and located in Bhilwara, India, is a wholesale distributor of dyes and chemicals. Its products include sulphur dyes, paraffin wax, phosphoric acid, sodium sulphide, hydrogen peroxide, citric acid, glycerine, phosphates and sodium nitrite, among other chemical and dye items.
